s.note: Smoked salmon blinis, and asparagus spears wrapped in crisp prosciutto
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill. Blanch a bunch of asparagus for a minute, wrap each spear in prosciutto and grill until crisp. Arrange both on trays for the first of several weddings.

s.note: Oatcakes with goat's cheese, roast beetroot, thyme and honey
s.how: Wrap 2 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, then cool, peel and slice thin. Spread oatcakes with goat's cheese. Top with beetroot, a few thyme leaves and a drizzle of honey and lay them out on a slate for a castle wedding in the Highlands.

m.note: Beef topside, Yorkshire puddings baked in muffin tins, roast potatoes
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg beef topside at 200C to medium and rest. Whisk 150g flour, 3 eggs and 300ml milk into a batter and bake in hot oiled muffin tins for 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside and make gravy with pan juices and stock.

w.note: Lemon sponge layers filled with lemon curd and whipped cream
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and lemon zest, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, ice white and decorate with fresh flowers.

d.note: Elderflower cordial and lemon in a flute with a cucumber ribbon, topped with bubbles
d.how: Peel 1 Lebanese cucumber into long ribbons and curl one into each of 4 flutes or wine glasses. Add 20ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each. Top slowly with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle. For drivers, use sparkling water and a little extra cordial.
